prompt: A pricing card with a monthly and yearly toggle, a plan name, the price, three feature lines that each have a check icon, and a buy button.
A settings sidebar with five links (Profile, Billing, Team, Notifications, Security), an icon for each, a highlighted active link that changes on click, and a footer showing the signed-in user.
A login form with email and password fields, an error line under each field when its value is invalid, a show-password button, and a submit button that stays disabled until both fields are valid.
A table of eight invoices with columns for number, customer, amount and status, a colored status badge, sorting by amount when its header is clicked, and a total row at the bottom.
A dashboard with a row of four stat cards (revenue, users, orders, churn) each with a small arrow icon showing the trend, and below them a line chart of twelve months of revenue.
A notification center with three buttons (Success, Warning, Error) that each show a toast message, and a list of the last five messages shown, with a clear button.
